questions.text: Does this post portray a group of people (by race, nationality, religion, politics, or gender) as contemptible, subhuman, or a threat?
Does this post contain slurs or dehumanizing language about a group?
Is this post engineered to provoke angry replies or quote-posts, such as a deliberately inflammatory or wrong take?
Does this post make an inflammatory claim that is unsourced, unfalsifiable, or likely fabricated?
Is this a culture-war engagement prompt ("who agrees?", "thoughts?", polls about groups) rather than information or genuine discussion?
